连接手柄后，点击重新检测。: Connect a controller, then click Scan again.
设置按键、摇杆和游戏动作: Set up buttons, sticks and game actions
选择手柄、检查输入和校准: Select a controller, inspect input and calibrate
按快捷键或游戏光标切换配置: Switch profiles using a shortcut or the game cursor
安装组件、设置输出和排查问题: Install components, configure output and troubleshoot
将手柄操作转换为键盘、鼠标或虚拟手柄输入，支持体感瞄准。: Map controller input to a keyboard, mouse or virtual controller, with support for gyro aiming.
组合键、配置层和详细调校参数可在游戏配置中展开。: Open a game profile to configure chords, action layers and detailed tuning.
避免重复输入。停止映射后恢复本次隐藏的手柄。: Prevent duplicate input. Controllers hidden by this session become visible again when mapping stops.
在游戏配置中选择键鼠或虚拟手柄。: Choose keyboard and mouse or a virtual controller in the game profile.
停止映射或观察后可安装组件。: Stop mapping or input monitoring before installing components.
按需调整输出实现、设备隐藏和诊断工具。: Configure output backends, controller hiding and diagnostic tools as needed.
键鼠与虚拟手柄 · 显示同步: Keyboard, mouse and virtual controller · Display sync
首次启用映射时，Windows 会请求管理员授权来创建虚拟设备；同一引擎会话中的: The first time mapping starts, Windows requests administrator approval to create virtual devices. Pausing and switching profiles reuse the helper process within the same engine session.
按下按键或转动摇杆，查看实时反馈。: Press a button or move a stick to see live feedback.
手柄操作模式仅预览按键和摇杆。: Controller navigation previews buttons and sticks only.
从配置库选择配置，或新建自己的游戏配置。: Choose a profile from the library or create your own game profile.
